description: Public subset of the GitNexus vs ripgrep+reading A/B (2026-10-05). Tasks on three private repositories are omitted.
commit_source: Commit at run time per repository, from the GitNexus index registry snapshot taken after the runs, cross-checked against the index refresh log and verified to exist on GitHub. The working directory of every run was that repository's index checkout at this commit.

kinds.find: find a function from a paraphrased description; answer up to 3 `path :: name` candidates
kinds.callers: find the definition and every direct non-test call site
kinds.impact: list hop-1 and hop-2 non-test functions affected by a signature change
kinds.broad: open-ended code-understanding question, answer in at most 400 words, blind-graded
